# Salvia

> Salvia turns a post-encounter voice note into a policy-checked, audit-locked clinical record before anyone signs off. AI + audio + clinical documentation + compliance, built for every clinical specialty. Not a scribe — a compliance suite.

Salvia is a clinical governance automation platform. Clinicians dictate a post-encounter voice note; Salvia transcribes, extracts structured fields into the right statutory form, runs it against the clinic's linked regulatory framework pack, and locks the record with an audit trail. Every note checks itself. Every record defends itself.

Salvia is a global, domain-agnostic product. The current launch market is India — clinics, small hospitals, dental and veterinary practices — with records mapped to Indian frameworks (NMC/IMC record rules, NABH, ABDM, DPDP Act, Schedule H1, Consumer Protection Act 2019). International frameworks (UK, AU, NZ, US, IE) ship in the same catalog.

## Product pillars

- [Point-of-Care Evidence](https://hellosalvia.com/products/point-of-care-evidence): Audio capture → transcription → structured field extraction → typed clinical record. Works with code-mixed Indian-language dictation (Hindi/Malayalam/English).
- [Statutory Form Infrastructure](https://hellosalvia.com/products/statutory-form-infrastructure): Jurisdiction- and vertical-specific forms with typed widgets (consent, drug register, incident, pain scale) — never free text where structure is required.
- [Institutional Compliance Hub](https://hellosalvia.com/products/institutional-compliance-hub): Policy framework linked to forms; every submission is policy-checked pre sign-off, with full audit trail and PDF export themed per clinic.

## Verticals

- [General practice & clinics](https://hellosalvia.com/general-practice): IMC Ethics 2002 record rules (3-year retention, 72-hour patient copies), NABH / NABH Entry-Level, ABDM/ABHA, Clinical Establishments Act, PC-PNDT, Telemedicine Practice Guidelines 2020.
- [Dental](https://hellosalvia.com/dental): Dentists Act 1948 / DCI Code of Ethics 2014 records, NABH Entry-Level for dental clinics, consumer-court-defensible charting.
- [Veterinary](https://hellosalvia.com/veterinary): VCI practice standards, Schedule H1 drug register, structured SOAP records.
- [Allied health](https://hellosalvia.com/allied-health): Physiotherapy, osteopathy, chiropractic, occupational therapy, podiatry, speech therapy — structured outcome measures and session records. Six disciplines as dedicated pages.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://hellosalvia.com/)
- [Pricing](https://hellosalvia.com/pricing): India pricing in INR, per-clinic (not per-seat), AI included on every tier. Starter ₹1,000/mo (400 AI notes), Clinic ₹3,000/mo (1,500 notes), Group ₹6,000/mo (3,000 notes, multi-location); annual = 2 months free; hospitals and high-volume on custom quotes. Excl. GST 18%.
- [Frameworks](https://hellosalvia.com/frameworks): Public catalog of every regulatory framework Salvia generates records against — Indian frameworks first, filterable by country and vertical.
- [Early access signup](https://hellosalvia.com/start)

## Regulatory frameworks supported

Salvia ships a hand-curated regulatory framework pack per clinic context (country + vertical + discipline). The pack splices into every AI form-gen prompt automatically.

- India: IMC/NMC Ethics Regulations 2002 (records + 72-hour access), NABH, NABH Entry-Level (SHCO), ABDM/ABHA, DPDP Act 2023, Clinical Establishments Act 2010, Consumer Protection Act 2019, Schedule H1 register, PC-PNDT, Telemedicine Practice Guidelines 2020, VCI, DCI Code of Ethics.
- International catalog: UK (RCVS PSS, CMA Remedies, VMR, CQC Reg 17, GDC, HCPC, GOsC, GCC), Australia (AHPRA boards, ARPANSA, AVA), New Zealand (VCNZ, NZDA, MCNZ, PBNZ, OTBNZ, OCNZ, CBNZ, NZSTA), United States (AVMA, AAHA, ADA CDT, FSBPT, NBCOT, ASHA, HIPAA), Ireland (CORU boards), cross-cutting GDPR and ISO 27001.
